title: Quick Persona Sign-in widget present on production login screen
domain: C. UX AND FLOWS / G. SECURITY
rootCause: Development quick launcher buttons exposed in UI allowing one-click mock login with prefilled hardcoded credentials.
fix: Removed quick persona block and sanitized state defaults to empty strings with standard enterprise placeholders.

title: Actionable Work Queue header text and tab strip horizontal overlap collision
domain: A. RESPONSIVE LAYOUT / B. LOOK AND FEEL
rootCause: Header flex container lacked flex-wrap; title (155px) and tabs (322px) exceeded usable width (400.8px), causing 'ACTIONABLE WARK(12) UE' collision.
fix: Added flex-wrap and gap-y-2 to queue header in APWorkstationGrid.tsx.

title: KPI financial metric cards monospace tabular figures overflow and clipping
domain: A. RESPONSIVE LAYOUT / B. LOOK AND FEEL
rootCause: 5-card single horizontal row on lg viewports squashed card width to 131px (103px usable width), clipping 17-character monospace strings (e.g. 'INR 15,26,812.00').
fix: Rebalanced grid breakpoints to md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-12 and scaled typography cleanly with truncate and min-w-0.

title: Header timestamp awkward multiline break on 'am'/'pm'
rootCause: Unconstrained flex item allowed 'Updated 10:53' and 'am' to split across lines.
fix: Added whitespace-nowrap and flex-wrap gap tokens to timestamp in OverviewPage.tsx.
